mechanism: Cimetidine reduces gastric pH and may decrease atovaquone absorption, which is pH-dependent and enhanced by fatty meals; cimetidine may also inhibit atovaquone metabolism via CYP450 enzymes.
action: Monitor atovaquone efficacy closely; ensure adequate absorption by administering with food; consider alternative H2-blocker (famotidine) or proton pump inhibitor if clinically necessary, or separate dosing times.
